text: When Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) listed on the Dubai Financial Market in April 2022, selling 18% of its share capital, the Government of Dubai continued to own 82%.
short: The Government of Dubai owns 82% of DEWA.

source.name: The National: 'IPO of Dubai's Dewa set to raise $6.1bn in second largest ever listing in Middle East'
source.quote: Following completion of the IPO, the Dubai Government will continue to own 82 per cent of Dewa's share capital.
